person_note: The Goodreads material repeatedly exposes Sookie as the participating “I” across action, reflection, telepathy, and dialogue framing. The authorized publisher excerpt independently sustains that same first-person voice in an interior scene, while Harris’s interview explicitly identifies the books as first-person narration from Sookie’s viewpoint. Second-person wording in q01897 is only Sookie’s quoted self-address, and first-person passages spoken by Eric or other characters are local dialogue rather than alternate base narration. No evidence indicates sustained sections in another narrative person; the main limitation is that the authorized excerpt covers an interior section rather than the complete book.
